text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text: "My dear sister——"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"How are you spending the holiday season? 
New Year's is the biggest event in Japan, 
and everyone returns to their hometowns."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text:
""So the academy is quite quiet right now. 
But because of that, I'm delighted to have 
the opportunity to chat with those who 
stayed behind...""

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"—I see. So that's why you didn't go home 
this year either, Ikuno-chan."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Even if I returned home this year, 
our whole family wouldn't have been able 
to gather. As such, I decided to remain at 
the academy and focus on 
self-improvement."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"My parents are devoted to their work and 
are away for lectures and overseas 
training. My younger sisters are attending 
club and cram school training camps. It is 
proof that they, too, have grown."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, what a wonderful family. So that 
explains why I've been running into you at 
the gym so often lately!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I wish to train rigorously and make 
this a meaningful winter break. If I may 
be ambitious, I would like to enrich my 
time outside of study and training as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I totally get that! You want to do 
something different for a change, right? 
It's winter break, after all... and 
Japanese New Year's, too!"

"—Hahaha! Sounds great! Why not let loose 
and go all out?"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text:
""And then, and then, dearest sister! 
Through this experience, I saw something 
truly wonderful.""

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text: ""What do you think it was—?""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"—I guess everyone thinks alike. 
Refreshing yourself is important, after 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Right?! You've gotta enjoy your vacation♪ 
The three of us were just talking about 
taking a trip somewhere together!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah! That sounds so exciting! A trip 
with just students... how wonderfully 
lovely!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm... I see. Since most of your travels 
were for official duties, traveling with 
classmates must feel quite novel to you."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu... I'd love to hear all about your 
adventures when you get back♪"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, then why don't you come with us! 
You too, Ikuno."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, your eyes were just sparkling 
with excitement. ...What do you say?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds splendid, by all means. 
Doesn't this sound like it could be a 
meaningful experience, Fine-san?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm, I am so, so happy for the 
invitation, but... I must apologize! I 
would surely cause trouble for you all."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"My security detail would worry about my 
safety as well. Please, don't mind me. Go 
on and enjoy yourselves, everyone♪"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I get it. So the issues are 'personal 
safety' and the 'burden on your security 
detail,' right? We just need to clear 
those hurdles."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, won't you leave it to me? 
I'll think everything through and make 
sure your security detail is convinced."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"No, really, it's alright. Just the 
thought alone means the world to me."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Worry not. If she is going this far, you 
can rest easy and leave it in her hands."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...! Wait, what...?! Even Air Groove-san 
is on board~?!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "What is it?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's just, I was completely sure you 
would oppose it...! You're usually much 
more cautious, aren't you? And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "Ahahaha! Then Fine is coming too!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"As for the destination... hmm, how does 
'Kyoto' sound?"

text_block_list.name: Groove & Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...! Kyoto, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"It provides an authentic Japanese 
atmosphere, which is lovely. I believe it 
is a fitting choice for a New Year's 
trip."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Right? I've been wanting to take my time 
and explore it properly, too. Alright, 
let's start working out a plan right 
away!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I will leave that to you, then. I shall 
lay the groundwork with her security 
detail. Let us regroup tonight."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "My goodness...! Oh, my goodness...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"—So, I chose a hotel with top-notch 
security, and I've compiled a list of 
hospitals and police boxes so we'll 
immediately know where the nearest one is 
no matter where we are."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, traffic info is accounted for, and 
even the emergency response flowchart is 
complete... With this level of 
preparation, the security detail should be 
satisfied."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"(How rare~! Groove-san didn't find a 
single flaw...! But indeed, with a plan 
like this...!)"

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text:
""And just like that, our senpais 
persuaded the head of security in no time 
flat...!""

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"To think they really, truly gave 
permission...! Ahh... should I set my 
alarm for 4:00 AM?!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That's far too early. Don't work yourself 
up. Come on, go to sleep already."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Bandages, compresses, headache 
medicine... eye masks and earplugs as 
well. Someone might suffer from insomnia 
in an unfamiliar environment."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"After all, 'the trip isn't over until you 
are safely home.' I shall manage 
everything to the very end to ensure all 
of us stay happy and healthy."

text_block_list.name: Fine's Letter
text_block_list.text:
""And so, the very next day! Full of 
excitement, we arrived in Kyoto!""
